CAP. 252] Belize Copyright
6
CHAPTER 252
75 of 2001. COPYRIGHT (SPECIFIED COUNTRIES) ORDER
[19th May, 2001.]
Short title. 1. This Order may be cited as the
COPYRIGHT (SPECIFIED COUNTRIES) ORDER.
Specified Countries. 2. (1) The countries specified in the Schedule to this Order, being
Schedule. members of the Berne Convention for the Protection of Literary and Artistic
Works of 1886 as revised and amended, are hereby declared to be specified
countries for the purposes of copyright protection in Belize pursuant to section
3(1)as read with section 143 of the Act.
(2) Where a country becomes a party to the Berne Convention
for the Protection of Literary and Artistic Works of 1886, as revised and
amended, after the commencement of this Order, the provisions of, and the
benefits of copyright protection conferred by, this Order shall apply to such
country with effect from the date it becomes a party to the Convention.
Proof of status as a 3. Any circular, notice or list which may be issued by the World Intellectual
Berne Convention Property Organisation from time to time, setting out the Countries which are
country. parties to the Berne Convention for the Protection of Literary and Artistic
Works, and the dates on which such countries became parties to the Convention,
shall be sufficient proof of a country(cid:146)s membership of the Convention for the
purposes of paragraph 2(2) of this Order.
Commencement. 4. This Order shall come into force on signature.
